annotations.title: Terms of service and privacy policy review

description: Terms of service and privacy policy review — Plain-English review of a terms of service, EULA or privacy policy: document type, company, 3-sentence summary, data collected, who data is shared with, user rights, auto-renewal / cancellation / refunds, disputes (forced arbitration, class-action waiver, opt-out window, venue), liability cap, content license, unilateral-change clause, red flags with short quotes and severity, a user-friendliness score 0-100 and grade A-F. Offline keyword signals cross-check arbitration, class-action waiver, auto-renewal, data selling or ad sharing, unilateral changes, termination at will, perpetual content licenses, liability limits, retention and children's data. Param: text (up to 24,000 characters). Not legal advice. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: e.g. Terms of Service. By using the Service you agree to these terms. Your subscription will automatically renew each month until cancelled. We may modify these terms at any time by posting the revised terms. You grant us a worldwide, royalty-free, perpetual license to use content you upload. Any dispute will be resolved by binding arbitration and you waive any right to participate in a class action. We may suspend or terminate your account at any time for any reason. In no event shall our aggregate liability exceed $50. We share your personal information with third-party advertising partners.
